description: proposal.discard's happy path — the only socket-reachable status change (TD1): discarding loosens nothing, so it needs no reason and no human-only door. A racing discard/decide (someone else committed or rejected first) is NOT an RPC error here — see discard-already-decided.json — because a racing decider is an outcome the UI renders inline, not an exceptional failure (design.md §2's own worked example).
